RUSSIA EXPECTS ITS 2027 FEDERAL BUDGET DEFICIT TO BE AROUND 2% OF GDP, WITH PROJECTIONS BASED ON A CONSERVATIVE OIL PRICE ASSUMPTION OF ABOUT $50 PER BARREL, PRESIDENT VLADIMIR PUTIN SAID. HE ADDED THAT OIL AND GAS REVENUES ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE, ALLOWING THE GOVERNMENT TO REPLENISH ITS WELLBEING
PUTIN ALSO SAID RUSSIA’S ECONOMY IS EXPECTED TO GROW ABOUT 1% IN 2026, INFLATION IS GRADUALLY SLOWING, AND THE FEDERAL BUDGET POSTED A RUB 606 BILLION SURPLUS IN AUGUST. ( @FirstSquaw )
